verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no AI assistant built into Drata that users can delegate tasks to. The natural-language claim (drata-docs-2) and the MCP server (drata-docs-54, drata-probe-4) let external AI agents interact with Drata, which belongs to a different story. The 'Drata Agent' on GitHub is a read-only device-monitoring app, not an AI assistant.
